content.text:
Excellent! All 272 tests pass. I've successfully added the customer merge functionality to handle duplicate customers:

**Added to src/errors.js:**
- SAME_CUSTOMER error code

**Added to src/customers.js:**
- `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` function that:
  - Returns ok({ customers, invoices }) where fromId's customer is removed and their invoices are reassigned to intoId
  - Normalizes both customer IDs before processing
  - Returns CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND if either ID doesn't exist in the customers array
  - Returns SAME_CUSTOMER if both IDs refer to the same customer
  - Never mutates the input arrays (creates deep copies)
  - Handles mixed-case and extra spaces in customer IDs

**Comprehensive test coverage in test/customers.test.js:**
- Basic merge functionality
- ID normalization (lowercase, spaces)
- Error conditions (SAME_CUSTOMER, CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
- No-mutation guarantees
- Preservation of invoice data (lines, payments)
- Multiple invoices per customer
- Edge cases (empty invoices, no invoices for fromId)
- Preservation of other customers' invoices
